verdict.rationale: Weave tracks the underlying metrics needed—cost (docs-12,13,27,33,34), execution metadata implying latency (docs-4,30), failure/error signals (docs-16,28,36,42), and eval scores via Evaluations/Scorers/Leaderboards (docs-6,23,25,31,38)—and surfaces them in calls tables, leaderboards, and Slack/webhook alerts (docs-17,28,36). However the evidence never describes a true customizable dashboard builder (arranging/combining these metrics into user-defined panels/views) as it would in W&B Models; it only shows fixed UI tables, leaderboards, and alert routing. Missing for 10: explicit custom dashboard/widget builder UI, cross-metric correlation views, and independent hands-on confirmation of dashboard customization.
